urdu.long_meaning: Mahathir (مہاتیر) سنسکرت زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم مہاتیر، بڑا تیر ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

arabic.name: مَهَاتِير
arabic.long_meaning: Mahathir (مَهَاتِير) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة السنسكريتية، ومعناه الأساسي مَهَاتِير، السَّهْمُ الْعَظِيم. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Mahathir is associated with the Sanskrit form مَهَاتِير, whose core sense is mahathir; great arrow (malay).

faq.q: What is the origin of Mahathir?
faq.a: Mahathir is associated with Sanskrit. Mahathir is a Malay male given name, from Sanskrit mahā ('great') + tīra ('arrow').
No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.
Mahathir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mahathir should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Mahathir is a Sanskrit-derived name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Mahathir mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Mahathir is rendered مہاتیر and carries the sense مہاتیر، بڑا تیر.

faq.q: What does Mahathir mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Mahathir is rendered ماهاتیر and carries the sense ماهاتیر، تیر بزرگ.
A romanized syllable approximation is ma-hat-hir. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Mahathir?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Mahathir, mahathir. Script forms are ماهاتیر, مهاتير, مَهَاتِير, مہاتیر, महातिर.

faq.q: Is Mahathir a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
